card.name: Patient counseling cross-references and advise-patients
card.fires_on: Fires on the end of 'Advise' (the 'ise' piece) before 'patients', and on punctuation inside 'Patient Counseling Information (17)' cross-references in drug labels. Also fires on a few words just before 'patients' or 'cost'.

modes.label: Advise patients
modes.description: The 'ise' ending of 'Advise' at the start of a counseling instruction.

modes.label: Counseling section reference
modes.description: The comma or open parenthesis right after 'Patient Counseling Information' before section 17.

modes.label: Words before patients or users
modes.description: A linking word just before a group such as patients.
modes.example: the potential for overdosage<< by>> patients is low.

card.writes: It pushes toward words like user, users, installation and configuration, which fits text about who the instruction is for.
card.plain: It marks spots in a label where the text is about telling patients something or pointing to the patient counseling section.
